_ordering_rationale: Private Client Group (segment dominant ~70% du CA), Capital Markets, Asset Management, Bank, AUA et FA count en bas. RJF fiscal year se termine 30 septembre.

kpis.signal: Segment dominant, wealth management $1.67T AUA, croissance soutenue
kpis.description_fr: Net revenues du segment Private Client Group : wealth management, financial advisors employes et independants, fee-based + brokerage + RJBDP fees. Coeur historique Raymond James. ~70% du CA total.
kpis.description_en: Private Client Group segment net revenues: wealth management, employee and independent financial advisors, fee-based + brokerage + RJBDP fees. Raymond James historical core. ~70% of total revenue.

kpis.signal: Cyclique, recovery M&A et equity underwriting apres creux FY23
kpis.description_fr: Net revenues du segment Capital Markets : M&A advisory, equity et debt underwriting, sales & trading institutionnel, fixed income et equities. Tres cyclique, sensible aux conditions de marche.
kpis.description_en: Capital Markets segment net revenues: M&A advisory, equity and debt underwriting, institutional sales & trading, fixed income and equities. Highly cyclical, sensitive to market conditions.

kpis.signal: Fee-based recurrent lie aux AUM Carillon Tower et Eagle Asset
kpis.description_fr: Net revenues du segment Asset Management : management fees sur fonds geres (Carillon Tower Advisers, Eagle Asset Management) et fee-based administrative services. Revenue recurrent indexe sur AUM.
kpis.description_en: Asset Management segment net revenues: management fees on managed funds (Carillon Tower Advisers, Eagle Asset Management) and fee-based admin services. Recurring revenue indexed to AUM.

kpis.signal: Pic FY23 sur hausse taux, normalisation depuis, NIM compresse
kpis.description_fr: Net revenues du segment Bank : net interest income sur portefeuille de prets (corporate, residential mortgage, SBL, securities-based lending) et residential deposits. Tres sensible aux taux Fed.
kpis.description_en: Bank segment net revenues: net interest income on loan portfolio (corporate, residential mortgage, SBL, securities-based lending) and residential deposits. Highly sensitive to Fed rates.

kpis.signal: Croissance soutenue, mix flux nets positifs + appreciation marche
kpis.description_fr: Total Client Assets Under Administration dans le segment PCG. Indicateur cle wealth management : reflete recrutement FA, flux nets et performance marche. Dont ~60% fee-based AUA.
kpis.description_en: Total Client Assets Under Administration in PCG segment. Key wealth management metric: reflects FA recruiting, net flows and market performance. ~60% fee-based AUA.

kpis.signal: Croissance regulière des effectifs FA, recrutement competitif
kpis.description_fr: Nombre de financial advisors employes + independent contractor affilies RJF en fin d exercice. Driver direct des AUA et net revenues PCG. Modele multi-affiliation (employee, independent contractor, RIA).
kpis.description_en: Employee + independent contractor financial advisors affiliated with RJF at year-end. Direct driver of PCG AUA and net revenues. Multi-affiliation model (employee, IC, RIA).
